notes.title: Don't miss out on Minotaur Princess during NextFest
notes.notes:
Hello Royal Minotaurs & Princesses!

We are super excited to announce that we are participating in Steam NextFest 2023, don't miss out on this fantastic opportunity to play our demo for a limited time only!

Remember that NextFest ends on February 13th and after that the demo won't be playable anymore.

Join us on [url=https://discord.gg/JRNGWPM6Uf]Discord[/url] and let us know what you think! Any comments and suggestions are much appreciated.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1885400/Minotaur_Princess/

notes.title: I Dev AMA + Let's Play!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41875729/9971303c8646056b4f7bed1ba70567ceab0e6330.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]
[h1][b]Greetings, Princesses & Bulls! 🐮👑[/b][/h1]

It's Charles here, the creative director behind our beloved puzzle fighter Minotaur Princess. 
We have such an incredible community. It feels like you’re a part of our team!

So! The team and I would like to invite you all for our [h3][b]first AMA + Let's Play session! 💬🎮[/b][/h3] 

Join our [b][url=https://discord.gg/FMYBRCaPnE]Discord server[/url][/b] and stay tuned on the #announcements channel. This Thursday (December 22nd), we will be waiting for you over the Lobby voice channel, at 1 PM EST! 
Feel free to ask anything about the game and its development, and be ready for some sneak peeks!


See you in our [b][url=https://discord.gg/FMYBRCaPnE]Discord realm[/url][/b]! Bring your questions and hammers.
[b][i]Bunnies4peace Studios[/i][/b]
